title: Sunburst hierarchy
intent: Show part-to-whole relationships across two visible hierarchy depths using nested annular sectors.

ai.create: Create a two-ring sunburst from a typed hierarchy using d3-hierarchy partition output and a responsive D3 arc generator with inherited branch colors.
ai.maintain: Update leaf values while preserving hierarchy order, stable ancestry-path keys, global angular allocation, responsive ring thickness, and branch color inheritance.
